verdict.rationale: CrewAI is fundamentally code/CLI-first (Agents, Tasks, Flows, CLI commands) and its Enterprise/AMP layer explicitly exposes deployed crews via REST API and webhooks, suggesting broad API parity. However, some UI-only conveniences (Crew Studio no-code builder, Visual Agent/Task Builders) are enterprise-exclusive with no confirmed programmatic equivalent, and no public OpenAPI/swagger spec was discoverable, leaving API completeness unverified.
